name: Familial Platelet Disorder with RUNX1 Mutation

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Proposed Diagnostic Criteria for Familial Platelet Disorder with RUNX1 Mutation

criteria.description: Presence of autosomal dominant family history of thrombocytopenia
Identification of pathogenic germline RUNX1 mutation by genetic testing
Persistent mild to moderate thrombocytopenia with platelet counts typically between 50-150 x10^9/L
Demonstration of platelet functional abnormalities such as impaired aggregation or secretion
Personal or family history of myeloid malignancies including MDS or AML

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of thrombocytopenia with a pathogenic germline RUNX1 mutation and compatible family history
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires genetic confirmation; platelet function testing and family history support diagnosis.

occasional.symptomName: Recurrent infections secondary to marrow dysfunction

rare.symptomName: Neurological symptoms secondary to bleeding (e.g., intracranial hemorrhage)

laboratory: Mild to moderate thrombocytopenia (platelet count 50-150 x10^9/L)
Abnormal platelet aggregation and secretion studies
Bone marrow dysplasia in some cases
imaging: Bone marrow biopsy showing dysplasia or progression to MDS/AML
genetic: Germline pathogenic RUNX1 mutation detected by sequencing
other: Family history of thrombocytopenia and myeloid malignancies
Increased risk of progression to hematologic malignancies

distinguishingFeatures: Lack of predisposition to myeloid malignancies
Small platelets rather than normal or large

redFlags: Family history of thrombocytopenia with hematologic malignancies
Development of myelodysplastic syndrome or acute leukemia
references: Song WJ, et al. Haploinsufficiency of RUNX1 causes familial platelet disorder with propensity to myeloid malignancy. Nat Genet. 1999.
Owen C, et al. Familial platelet disorder with RUNX1 mutation: clinical and laboratory features. Blood. 2016.
Arber DA, et al. Familial platelet disorder with predisposition to acute myeloid leukemia: a review. Hematol Oncol Clin North Am. 2017.
